description: Source code for FrameworkRPC.cpp implementing content decryption and DRM system factory management within WPEFramework plugin, including classes for external access, buffer management, session handling, and system factory registration.

classes.name: OCDMImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing content decryption and DRM system management, including system factory registration, session handling, and plugin initialization.

classes.name: ExternalAccess
classes.description: Handles external IPC communication for the OCDM plugin.

classes.name: AccessorOCDM
classes.description: Provides access to DRM systems, manages sessions, and handles system factory instances.

classes.name: BufferAdministrator
classes.description: Manages buffer allocation and release for DRM sessions.

classes.name: SessionImplementation
classes.description: Represents a DRM session, manages session data, and handles key status updates.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration container for plugin settings, including system definitions and blacklists.

classes.name: Systems
classes.description: Represents individual DRM system configuration within the plugin.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the OCDM plugin, loads DRM factories, and sets up communication channels.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, releasing resources and deinitializing factories.

methods.name: IsTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given key system and content type are supported.

methods.name: KeySystem
methods.description: Retrieves the media keys interface for a specified key system.
